vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
降低目标的攻击力
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
立刻重置冷却
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
吸收一定伤害、按比例减少受到的伤害，或把受到的伤害延迟结算（如统帅朗姆酒、虚妄之诺）
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
飞行移动，能越过地形
提供目标或区域的视野
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
制造自身或他人的幻象
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
攻击或技能恢复自身生命：按造成的伤害、按目标生命或每次攻击固定值（攻击吸血、技能吸血、如噬魂鬼·盛宴、附魂面具）
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
为自己恢复或从其他单位抽取法力（如莱恩法力吸取），含属性回蓝和回蓝倍率；对友军生效且能给自己回蓝的也算
移动不受单位碰撞阻挡
攻击无视闪避（必中）
主动使已飞来的弹道落空；“无法被躲避”的说明不算
目标无法移动；带ROOT_DISABLES字段的位移（所有闪烁类）也不能使用
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
能摧毁树木
能穿过树木移动

objects.subject: abyssal_underlord_firestorm
objects.description_zh: 召唤数波火焰风暴攻击目标区域内的所有单位，并额外持续造成烧灼伤害。
objects.description_en: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.

shard.zh: 火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。
shard.en: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

objects.subject: abyssal_underlord_pit_of_malice
objects.description_zh: 在目标区域制造致命的深渊；踏入深渊的敌方单位将受到伤害并且被缠绕。每个敌方单位每隔%pit_interval%秒才会再次受到作用。
objects.description_en: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every %pit_interval% seconds.

objects.subject: abyssal_underlord_atrophy_aura
objects.description_zh: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
objects.description_en: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
notes_zh: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。

objects.subject: abyssal_underlord_raid_boss
objects.description_zh: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得%dark_portal_multiplier%倍加成。
objects.description_en: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive %dark_portal_multiplier%x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

objects.subject: abyssal_underlord_dark_portal
objects.description_zh: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法%warp_channel_duration%秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过%minimum_distance%。
objects.description_en: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for %warp_channel_duration% seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least %minimum_distance% away from each other.
notes_zh: 双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。

scepter.zh: 在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。
scepter.en: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

objects.subject: monkey_king_boundless_strike
objects.description_zh: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
objects.description_en: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.

shard.zh: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的%spring_channel_pct%%%。棒击大地设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。
shard.en: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with %spring_channel_pct%%% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

objects.subject: monkey_king_tree_dance
objects.description_zh: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕%unperched_stunned_duration%秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
objects.description_en: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for %unperched_stunned_duration%s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
notes_zh: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

objects.subject: monkey_king_jingu_mastery
objects.description_zh: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下%charges%次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
objects.description_en: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns %charges% charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
notes_zh: 棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

objects.subject: monkey_king_wukongs_command
objects.description_zh: 齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的%attack_speed%秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
objects.description_en: Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of %attack_speed%s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
notes_zh: 猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。

scepter.zh: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。
scepter.en: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

objects.subject: pangolier_swashbuckle
objects.description_zh:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
objects.description_en:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes_zh: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

objects.subject: pangolier_shield_crash
objects.description_zh:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
objects.description_en:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.

scepter.zh: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成%scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%%伤害。
scepter.en: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals %scepter_damage_outgoing_tooltip%%% damage.

objects.subject: pangolier_lucky_shot
objects.description_zh: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。
objects.description_en: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

objects.subject: pangolier_rollup
objects.description_zh: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。
objects.description_en: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

objects.subject: pangolier_gyroshell
objects.description_zh:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有%magic_resistance%%%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with %magic_resistance%%% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要%move_speed_ramp_up_time%秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

objects.subject: pangolier_fortune_favors_the_bold
objects.description_zh: 附近敌人攻击石鳞剑士时，他们触发物品和技能的随机类攻击特效的几率有所降低。
objects.description_en: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes_zh: 对英雄技能和物品有效。
效果是特效发生的几率相对降低。

objects.subject: dark_willow_bramble_maze
objects.description_zh: %initial_creation_delay%秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出%placement_range%范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有%placement_count%棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续%placement_duration%秒。
objects.description_en: Dark Willow creates a %placement_range% AoE maze of %placement_count% brambles that grow in the target area after %initial_creation_delay% seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts %placement_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。

objects.subject: dark_willow_shadow_realm
objects.description_zh: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有%attack_range_bonus%额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过%max_damage_duration%秒将达到最高伤害。
objects.description_en: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has %attack_range_bonus% bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after %max_damage_duration% seconds.
notes_zh: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。

scepter.zh: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。
scepter.en: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

objects.subject: dark_willow_cursed_crown
objects.description_zh: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被眩晕。
objects.description_en: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.

shard.zh: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在%shard_spawn_radius%范围内产生%shard_bramble_amount%朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。
shard.en: Cursed Crown creates %shard_bramble_amount% brambles in a %shard_spawn_radius% radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

objects.subject: dark_willow_bedlam
objects.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。
objects.description_en: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

objects.subject: dark_willow_pixie_dust
objects.description_zh: 邪影芳灵获得额外%hp_regen_amp%%%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至%hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%%。
objects.description_en: Dark Willow gains %hp_regen_amp%%% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to %hp_regen_amp_out_of_world%%% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

objects.subject: dark_willow_terrorize
objects.description_zh: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
objects.description_en: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes_zh: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。

objects.subject: grimstroke_dark_artistry
objects.description_zh: 天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
objects.description_en: Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits. Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.

objects.subject: grimstroke_ink_creature
objects.description_zh:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
objects.description_en:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
notes_zh: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

objects.subject: grimstroke_spirit_walk
objects.description_zh: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。%buff_duration%秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
objects.description_en: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After %buff_duration% seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.

shard.zh: 墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加%shard_bonus_damage_pct%%%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的%shard_heal_pct%%%。驱散类型：弱驱散
shard.en: Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal %shard_bonus_damage_pct%%% more damage and heal the target for %shard_heal_pct%%% of the damage Ink Swell deals.DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

objects.subject: grimstroke_dark_portrait
objects.description_zh: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有%immunity_resist%%%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。
objects.description_en: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.
